g.title: LMS
g.text: NEBULA KNOWLAB | PostgreSQL entity relationship diagram
36 application tables · 61 enforced foreign keys · 12 November 2026
PK = primary key FK = foreign key UK = unique key ? = nullable
Parent → child: | = one o = zero/optional crow’s foot = many
Key columns + selected attributes shown. JSON/text references and code-defined courses are not extra SQL relationships.
